name: Protection from Poison

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch creature; remove Poisoned condition and grant Poison-save Advantage plus Poison Resistance for one hour; exact source cleanup.

rules.text: You touch a creature and end the Poisoned condition on it.
For the duration, the target has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition, and it has Resistance to Poison damage.
